title: 第21章 透明了第22章 夜宴
slug: 快穿之时空星河伴第九章误闯雾山
content_zh:
张文看昔小苑如此这样，随即有些担忧的说道：“大人，需要救火吗？”
昔小苑强忍着泪水说道：“不用了，一时半会儿也救不了。”
俞月白一脸疑惑的说道：“女神，你这是在等谁呢？？”
俞月白随后一脸不解的看向张文，张文耸了耸肩表示自己也不知道的样子。
张文很是小声的对俞月白，便道：“都不知道大人喊的那个…什么～阿丞…沐梓丞…是谁呢。”
俞月白默默的摇了摇头，随即小声的说道：“本公子也不知道呢～”
张文继而跟俞月白窃窃私语的说道：“大人等的会不会是那个‘看不见’的人？”
俞月白表情不清楚，随即小声说道：“本公子不知道呀…而且那个‘看不见’的人不是都对我们俩说了嘛～说不准提他的事，而且只要救出女神就行了…”
张文而后一脸同意的模样，随即缓缓的说道：“也对，我们俩已经答应过他了，我们就不能食言！不说便就不说了~而且他还说…当我们没有遇到过他，也不能把他的事说出去。”
俞月白和张文两人交换了个眼色，随即俩人点了点头，当是默认了。
昔小苑胸口突然不疼了，昔小苑看着那门口，不久便看见沐梓丞从火光虚弱的走了出来，她看着他整个人都快变的透明了。
昔小苑看见他还活着，自己内心满是欢喜，随即她嘴角忍不住的上扬，好看的脸庞满是笑容，像劫后余生的模样…
昔小苑狠狠地抹了抹脸上温热的泪水。看见他没事便好～
沐梓丞看昔小苑那脏兮兮的脸庞，他自个也忍不住笑了，嘴角满是笑意。
这女人怎么自己都搞得这么狼狈，跟个花猫一样脸上脏兮兮的。
俞月白跟张文都有些摸不着头脑的看了看昔小苑，俩人眼神动作交流着…
俞月白:女神这怎么了…
张文:不知道呀…
俞月白：这一会哭一会笑的，这让我很慌…
张文：我也不知道呀…

随后俩人互相使了个眼色，随即张文小声对俞月白说道：“大人的事咱们还是不要互相猜疑了，反正大人做什么都是对的，我们帮忙做事的听从安排便是……”
昔小苑等着沐梓丞慢慢的走了过来，沐梓丞走到昔小苑的身边，她随后转过身去对张文说道：“走吧，回去了。”
“好的…不过大人，您可能得跟着我们走回去了…因为~没有马车…”张文而后有些为难的说道。
昔小苑嗯了一声，随后无所谓的说道：“带路吧。”
不久天空下起了小雨，昔小苑看着天空任由着雨水打落在脸上，闭上眼睛深呼吸一口，理了理心态，而后睁开眼睛看着他们，微微一笑的说道：“走吧…”
沐梓丞跟在昔小苑的身旁，俩人也不说话，就这样安安静静的走着。
“谢谢…”昔小苑没有看着沐梓丞，而是看着前方小声说道。她虽然声音不大，但是沐梓丞还是听到了，他突然嘴角上扬。
在昔小苑他们走了之后，还有一个人逃了出来，他嘴角一笑，喃喃自语道：“可真有趣…真是越来越好玩了…”
……………………分割线…………………
土匪窝被剿的消息一下子传了开来，大街小巷都知道了…
“听说没有，那帮匪徒一夜之间被一窝端了，那土匪寨的老窝都被烧成了灰，一片废墟呢…”
“对呀对呀，这该死的日子可终于结束了…”
“听说是那外面来的官爷给剿了的，好像是当今丞相呢，而且还是位女子，可真是个女英雄呀…”
“那丞相大人人很心善，还给我们派发粮食，让我们终于不至于挨饿了…”
“你看！就是他们。”街上的百姓们看着街上那马车和官兵们。
昔小苑已经收拾好东西回程了，路上很多百姓围观，昔小苑拉开窗帘看了看他们。
content_en:
Zhang Wen saw Xi Xiaoyuan like this, and then he said with some worry: "Sir, do you need to put out the fire?"
Xi Xiaoyuan held back tears and said, "No need, we can't save him for a while."
Yu Yuebai said with a confused look: "Goddess, who are you waiting for??"
Yu Yuebai then looked at Zhang Wen with a puzzled expression, and Zhang Wen shrugged as if he didn't know.
Zhang Wen said to Yu Yuebai in a low voice, "I don't even know who the... what you are calling ~ A Cheng... Mu Zicheng... is."
Yu Yuebai shook his head silently, and then whispered: "I don't know either~"
Zhang Wen then whispered to Yu Yuebai: "Is it the 'invisible' person that you are waiting for?"
Yu Yuebai's expression was unclear, and then he whispered: "I don't know, sir...and didn't the 'invisible' person tell both of us? Maybe he's not allowed to be mentioned, and all he needs to do is rescue the goddess..."
Zhang Wen then looked in agreement, and then said slowly: "That's right, we have already promised him, and we can't break our promise! If we don't say it, we won't say it~ And he also said...As if we haven't met him, we can't tell anything about him."
Yu Yuebai and Zhang Wen exchanged glances, and then they nodded, taking it as acquiescence.
Xi Xiaoyuan's chest suddenly stopped hurting. Xi Xiaoyuan looked at the door and soon saw Mu Zicheng weakly walking out from the light of the fire. She almost turned transparent when she looked at him.
Xi Xiaoyuan saw that he was still alive, and her heart was full of joy. Then the corners of her mouth couldn't help but turn up, and her beautiful face was full of smiles, as if she was surviving a disaster...
Xi Xiaoyuan wiped the warm tears on her face fiercely. It'll be good to see him okay~
When Mu Zicheng looked at Xi Xiaoyuan's dirty face, he couldn't help but smile, and the corners of his mouth were full of smiles.
Why is this woman so embarrassed, her face as dirty as a tabby cat?
Yu Yuebai and Zhang Wen both looked at Xi Xiaoyuan confused, and their eyes and movements communicated...
Yu Yuebai: What happened to the goddess...
Zhang Wen: I don’t know…
Yu Yuebai: I cry and laugh sometimes, which makes me panic...
Zhang Wen: I don’t know either…
Then the two of them winked at each other, and then Zhang Wen whispered to Yu Yuebai: "Let's not doubt each other about your lord's affairs. Anyway, whatever your lord does is right. We should follow the arrangements to help..."
Xi Xiaoyuan waited for Mu Zicheng to walk over slowly. Mu Zicheng walked to Xi Xiaoyuan's side. She then turned around and said to Zhang Wen, "Let's go back."
"Okay...but sir, you may have to follow us back...because there is no carriage..." Zhang Wen then said with some embarrassment.
Xi Xiaoyuan hummed, and then said nonchalantly: "Lead the way."
Soon it started to rain lightly. Xi Xiaoyuan looked at the sky and let the rain fall on her face. She closed her eyes and took a deep breath to calm down her mind. Then she opened her eyes and looked at them. She said with a slight smile: "Let's go..."
Mu Zicheng followed Xi Xiaoyuan, and the two of them walked quietly without speaking.
"Thank you..." Xi Xiaoyuan did not look at Mu Zicheng, but looked ahead and whispered. Although her voice was not loud, Mu Zicheng still heard her, and the corners of his mouth suddenly raised.
After Xi Xiaoyuan and the others left, there was another person who escaped. He smiled and murmured to himself: "It's really interesting... It's getting more and more interesting..."
……………………Separating line………………
The news that the bandit den was wiped out spread all of a sudden, and everyone in the streets knew about it...
"I heard that the bandits were captured overnight, and the bandits' lair was burned to ashes and was in ruins..."
"Yes, yes, these damn days are finally over..."
"I heard it was from that placeThe official who came before me seems to be the current prime minister who was killed, and she is also a woman. She is really a heroine..."
"The Prime Minister is very kind-hearted and even distributes food to us, so that we will not starve at last..."
"Look! That's them. "The people on the street looked at the carriage and the officers and soldiers on the street.
Xi Xiaoyuan had already packed her things and returned. Many people were watching on the road. Xi Xiaoyuan opened the curtains and looked at them.
